# NEW 2026-11-17 theme names (updated 2026-11-24 v26.0 WP11: 79 imperial/historical regions + missing EU5 areas).
# Generated by gen_theme_names.py; edit the tables or data/oe_theme_regions_empire.json, not this file.
# Sources: Oxford Dictionary of Byzantium (themes); Notitia Dignitatum / Justinianic provinces.

# Theme (country) scope. Gives a theme its historical name once, from its seat; see gen_theme_names.py.
# Creation effects save the seat as scope:oe_theme_name_seat first: a new building country's capital link
# does not resolve inside the effect that creates it. Later calls (monthly pulse) fall back to the capital.
# 2026-11-18: the seat picks a base-name id (oe_theme_name_find_id); the name itself is set by oe_theme_name_by_id.
# In an option tooltip the engine dry-runs creation effects without setting variables, so no name shows there.
oe_theme_apply_name = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_theme_name_seat } exists = capital } capital = { save_scope_as = oe_theme_name_seat } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_named } exists = scope:oe_theme_name_seat }
        oe_theme_name_find_id = yes
        set_variable = oe_theme_named
        oe_theme_refresh_name = yes
    }
}

# Theme scope, after a status or course change (oe_ts_set_status, oe_ta_set_course). Only for a named theme:
# a creation dry-run has no variables, so it stops at the first check. BYT01 and themes with
# var:oe_theme_name_fixed keep their names.
oe_theme_refresh_name = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_named }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { tag = BYT01 } NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_name_fixed } }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_name_id } exists = capital }
                capital = { save_scope_as = oe_theme_name_seat }
                oe_theme_name_find_id = yes
            }
            if = { limit = { oe_ts_despot = yes } oe_theme_name_by_id = { sfx = DESPOT } }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes } oe_theme_name_charter = yes }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_ts_exarch = yes } oe_theme_name_by_id = { sfx = EXARCH } }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_sx_civil_type = yes } oe_theme_name_by_id = { sfx = CIVIL } }
            else = { oe_theme_name_by_id = { sfx = ARMY } }
        }
    }
}

# Theme scope, scope:oe_theme_name_seat saved. Base-name id by the seat: 78 imperial/historical regions (R02-R79), then map areas, then map regions.
oe_theme_name_find_id = {
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_name_seat = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_name_id value = 1 } } # OE_THEME_NAME_R_2
    else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_name_seat = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_name_id value = 2 } } # OE_THEME_NAME_R_3
    else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_name_seat = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_name_id value = 3 } } # OE_THEME_NAME_R_4

# Theme scope. A chartered city takes its seat city's name when the city is a known one, else the base name.
oe_theme_name_charter = {
    if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:venice } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_VENICE change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_VENICE_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:genoa } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_GENOA change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_GENOA_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:pisa } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_PISA change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_PISA_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:florence } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_FLORENCE change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_FLORENCE_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:milano } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_MILANO change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_MILANO_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:naples } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_NAPLES change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_NAPLES_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:rome } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_ROME change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_ROME_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:ravenna } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_RAVENNA change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_RAVENNA_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:bari } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_BARI change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_BARI_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:ancona } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_ANCONA change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_ANCONA_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:palermo } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_PALERMO change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_PALERMO_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:syracuse } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_SYRACUSE change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_SYRACUSE_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:messina } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_MESSINA change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_MESSINA_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:bologna } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_BOLOGNA change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_BOLOGNA_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:verona } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_VERONA change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_VERONA_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:lucca } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_LUCCA change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_LUCCA_ADJ }
    else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { this = location:siena } } change_country_name = OE_THEME_NAME_C_SIENA change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_NAME_C_SIENA_ADJ }
    else = { oe_theme_name_by_id = { sfx = CHARTER } }
}
